title: Profile, Documentation & Checklists - Update
description:
• **Pilot Profile**: Comprehensive career dashboard with lifetime flight statistics, 18 achievement badges with real-time progression, dedicated aircraft fleet analytics, and an interactive World Passport with aerodrome markers and route lines.
• **Interactive Checklists**: Standard operating procedures with clickable items, progress tracking, audio feedback, and full EFB companion integration.
• **Documentation & Guides**: Built-in developer and pilot documentation browser with release workflows, SimConnect/FSUIPC specifications, and operation guides.
• **ArcGIS World Imagery**: Upgraded all application map views to high-resolution satellite imagery.

title: EFB & Data Management - Update
description:
• **EFB Companion**: Integrated tablet & mobile companion server with QR code pairing and live telemetry streaming.
• **Export User Data**: Single select menu with full backup and segment exports.
• Improved dark mode contrast and accessibility.

title: Welcome to Apollo Flight
description: Track your flights, analyze landing rates, and export flight bundles seamlessly. Check this news menu for upcoming updates and release notes.
